notes: SD card slot (1x) omitted from port list as it is storage media, not a signal/power I/O connector. The manufacturer's own "Input/Output Ports" table caps SDI at "SD/HD/3G" (sdi-3g); other prose sections of the same spec sheet and third-party summaries mention 6G support for encode/processing, but the literal physical-port table lists only up to 3G-SDI, so sdi-3g was used per the authoritative port listing. HDMI is specified as "HDMI 1.4a, DVI-D" (no 2.0/2.1 support, no 4:2:2 12-bit color note applies to HDMI in but connector grade is hdmi-1.4). USB Type-C is explicitly labeled "(config)" — a configuration/service port, not confirmed as a data/DisplayAltMode port; USB generation/speed not stated for any USB port, so grade omitted. Ethernet supports PoE+ (802.3at) as power-over-data-cable, not a separate power connector. Device also has Wi-Fi (802.11a/b/g/n/ac) and supports a 4G/5G USB modem (not supplied) via the USB-A ports — not modeled as a physical port since it's a plugged-in accessory, not a built-in radio jack. Unit is a compact desktop encoder (214.9 x 128.2 x 44.55 mm) that ships with an optional 1U rack-mount kit; rackUnits omitted per instructions for desktop-first units. Cross-checked manufacturer webpage (magewell.com/tech-specs/ultra-encode-aio) and B&H/Amazon listings, all consistent with the PDF.
